subject: To manage the legend and the axes with ggplot

messages.author: e1de227f33c2dffc
messages.subject: To manage the legend and the axes with ggplot
parts:
Hello friends,

 I would like represented these two data on curves in evolutions with legend, of the points and without color but that do not do what I want!
I have problems with placed the legend
Here my code:

require(ggplot2)
An<-c(1990,2000:2012)
Mota1<-c(84,92,89.4,86.3,83,80,77.1,74.6,72.3,69.9,67.7,65,63,61.1)
Mota2<-c(34.6,36,35.3,34.5,33.6,32.9,32.1,31.4,30.7,30.1,29.5,28.9,28.3,27.9)
X<-data.frame(An,Mota1,Mota2)
ggplot(X,aes(Annee))+ 
  geom_line(aes(y = Mota1,colour= "Morta1" )) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = Mota2,colour = "Morta2"))+
   labs(x="An",y="Level of Mota",fill="X")


Thank you to help me

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: To manage the legend and the axes with ggplot
parts:
Suggestion: work through some introductory examples to ggplot
(available widely via google), so you understand ggplot's basics.

That said, here you want to reshape the data frame first, and then
things become very simple:

library(reshape2)
X1 <- melt(X, id.vars=1) # reshapes the data from 'wide' to 'long'
ggplot(X1, aes(An, value, color=variable))+geom_line()

Ben
